dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Welcome, guest from afar. Whatever light you come seeking, the Children of Echoes will respond with sincerity as solid and steady as the stones and as hot as the fires of the forge."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "In accordance with Chief Pacal's decree, all tribal matters will be announced here. (Note: Remember to tear down the old notices soon!)"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Super great news! The next Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame is starting soon, and many of our young warriors will represent our tribe in the war!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Participants include: The popular "Drillbit Dancer" Itzna, the veteran Tlaco, the biggest bro of the miner bros Kwila, our god of cooking Cempoa..."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "In addition, everyone's eyes will be on the renowned legendary contestant, the 'Sand Dagger of Seit'aad' Amuru as he embarks on another journey!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "And his old rival, the 'Calamity of Tetlahuitl' Nkunga has sharpened his axe and is hot on his heels!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "And that's not even close to all — another familiar face, the holder of an Ancient Name, Kachina, will also take part once more! We hope she'll do great this time! We hope everyone will cheer them on with all you've got!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "To guests from afar (Note: Remember not to tear this down again!) — This is known as the Stage Tepetl, and is where we usually hold dance competitions."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "If that interests you, why not just hop up on stage and dance with us?"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "In addition, just over the bridge is Muhuru's Gemporium. If you want to purchase any gemstone accessories, there's no better place!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "For large-scale ore and mineral trading: Take a right and head up along the stairs. Negotiate directly with Chief Pacal."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "On the other side of the steps is the Macuahuitl Workshop. If you need some seriously sturdy tools or weapons, you can't go wrong with them! Chief-approved!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Finally, whatever light you come seeking, the Children of Echoes will respond with sincerity as solid and steady as the stones and as hot as the fires of the forge. May your path shine brighter than gemstones."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "The Children of Echoes has 19 mining teams, of which 12 have fixed tasks within the tribe. 7 teams are available to be hired for mining or excavation tasks outside the tribe..."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "If you are interested in hiring a mining team, please prepare all the necessary documents before discussing the matter with Chief Pacal."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "We don't really like handling documents, and aren't too fussed with the details of various commercial terms. We trust that you aren't going to be too petty, play dirty, or try to take advantage of us."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Otherwise, we'll see you at Chasca's mediation table. Deals that end in discord are no good for anyone!"

dialogues.speaker: Drillbit Dance Dance-Off Announcement
dialogues.text: "The results of the 127751st Drillbit Dance daily dance-off have been announced! Itzna has won the crown, marking her 200th win in the daily dance-off!"

dialogues.speaker: Drillbit Dance Dance-Off Announcement
dialogues.text: "Children of Echoes, let's hear you make some noise! The next time we see Itzna, lift her onto your shoulders, throw her into the sky, and celebrate her success!"

dialogues.speaker: Drillbit Dance Dance-Off Announcement
dialogues.text: "In addition, Zacatula and Tlaco have now participated in the competition for 1200 and 1700 total days respectively! Give it up for our two old friends!"

dialogues.speaker: Drillbit Dance Dance-Off Announcement
dialogues.text: "And as for you youngsters watching the dancers from offstage, how can you still stay still?"

dialogues.speaker: Drillbit Dance Dance-Off Announcement
dialogues.text: "Get up on the stage, and dance, dance, dance! Become a member of the Drillbit Dance! Show us your courage and resolve, and you can also become a legend of the stage!"

dialogues.speaker: Graffiti Alliance Announcement
dialogues.text: "Smash it all!"

dialogues.speaker: Graffiti Alliance Announcement
dialogues.text: "Smash unchanging scenery, smash ordinary, dull colors, smash the regular, ordered life that lulls you into complacency and puts you to sleep!"

dialogues.speaker: Graffiti Alliance Announcement
dialogues.text: "Pick up your spray cans, and fill every flat wall, cliff face, and rock wall with the fruits of your imagination! The Graffiti Alliance is ready and waiting for you to join!"

dialogues.speaker: Graffiti Alliance Announcement
dialogues.text: "If you're interested in graffiti, drop by the Masters of the Night-Wind to register and join at any time! Find your crew, grab your gear, and let's go go go!"

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Children of Nanatzcayan, hear my voice."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "All is born from fleeting encounters, everything is a Blessing from fate."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "The horns of the tribes rumble to life, warning of tainted currents scheming in the darkness."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "The story begins at your feet, inspired by travelers from a distant land."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Brothers and sisters! In celebration of a victory hard won, and to remember those heroes who gave their lives to see it come to pass, let us convene at Stage Tepetl, as is our custom!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Let us raise a glass together, move our feet together, cheer our triumph together, and shower our heroes with gems and blessings as one!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Come one, come all, for a celebration that can't be missed! Such a great day demands we all come together. No one's to be left out!"
